effectSummary.ko: 자신과 경계 쇠뇌 사이의 거리가 5m 이상이면 그 쇠뇌의 피해가 가산 10% 증가합니다. 각 쇠뇌 사격 생성 시 거리를 확인합니다.
effectSummary.en: Watch Ballista gains +10% additive damage while the hero is at least 5m away. Check distance when each shot is created.

productionConcept: An enduring distance-support emblem: a miniature stout iron ballista head and a weathered leather boot separated by one broad pale trail wedge. The two substantial forms remain within a compact diagonal composition, symbolizing strength from maintaining distance, no floor.

Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Style: painterly dark gothic fantasy, worn iron, aged leather, bone and muted bronze, sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, restrained brush texture. Large readable forms, limited detail, strong shape distinction at 64px. Entire subject including glow and particles must fit inside central 76% of canvas, leaving at least 12% fully transparent margin on all four sides. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Use restrained cohesive effects rather than clouds of tiny particles.  Internal identity (do not render text): AP17 Pathfinder. Skill type: passive. Effect: Watch Ballista gains +10% additive damage while the hero is at least 5m away. Check distance when each shot is created. Tags: Passive. Linked equipment IDs for identity context only: LA03, LA10, LA23, LA24, LA25, LA26, LA27, LA28, DES_LA45. Subject and composition: An enduring distance-support emblem: a miniature stout iron ballista head and a weathered leather boot separated by one broad pale trail wedge. The two substantial forms remain within a compact diagonal composition, symbolizing strength from maintaining distance, no floor. FINAL FRAMING REQUIREMENT: a small isolated icon floating in extensive fully transparent empty space. Fit ALL visible content inside a centered square occupying only 60% of total canvas width and height; leave 20% absolutely empty transparent margins. Output resolution must be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels.
